plain_text:
Page 1 
Housing Committee 
August 12 , 2026  
 
The South Burlington Housing Committee was called to order at 6:00 PM on July 8th in 
City Hall, 180 Market Street and via Zoom.  
Committee members present included Chair Nora Senecal, Vince Bolduc, Sandy Dooley, 
Meghan Tedder, Mona Tolba and Tasos Zois.  Dawn Philibert was absent.  
Others present: Kelsey Peterson (Senior City Planner), and Elizabeth Fitzgerald, 
designated representative from the City Council. Cymone Bedford and Jazmine Hurley 
joined electronically. 
Elizabeth reported that the bond issue for Bartlett’s Bay Wastewater Treatment facility 
upgrade passed; that there would be a slight increase in property taxes; that a naming 
policy was discussed by the City Council; that the CC approved the Tier 1A application to 
the Land Use Review Board of the State; that an eminent domain application for a ROW 
on 1720 Spear Street was initiated to connect to South Point.  
Jazmine gave an impressive hour long presentation on how Winooski uses their housing 
trust fund.   
The next meeting will be Sept 9th. Vince Bolduc will be away.  
 
The Committee adjourned at 8:00. 
Respectfully submitted, 
Vince Bolduc, Secretary
